t: This is Devonshire Place in Marylebone, running from Marylebone Road in the north down to Devonshire Street. At the northern end stands The London Clinic, one of England's largest private hospitals. The street is named after William Cavendish, the fifth Duke of Devonshire, a nobleman and politician who was made a Knight of the Garter in 1782. Several notable people have lived here. The architect Sir Horace Jones, best known for Tower Bridge, which was finished after his death, died on this street in 1887.
